set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: W02
Accountable role (person not assigned): Frontend/integration engineer with curator

Outcome: A project shows its datasets, responsibilities and outstanding review work in one coherent workflow.

Acceptance:
- Provide project overview, authorized dataset search and bounded inventory/history navigation, assignment/status/notes for curation tasks, and an activity trail.
- Bind findings, reports and human review outcomes to exact releases; distinguish acceptance, automated checks and reviewed quality; new releases do not silently inherit approval.
- Keep task/attachment/search visibility within underlying dataset authority; curator and researcher complete daily work without operator CLI or internal UUID entry.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/vision.md
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: W02: Add project curation, release history and review work
